chunks: And he, peace be upon him, was asked: "Which charity is the best?"
He said: "To a relative who harbors enmity."

key_terms.الصَّدَقَةِ: charity; voluntary giving in the path of goodness
key_terms.الْكَاشِحِ: one who harbors enmity, rancor, or concealed hostility

ai.seo_question: Which kind of charity is considered the most excellent in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that one of the most virtuous forms of charity is giving to a blood relative even when that person bears ill will. It emphasizes maintaining kinship ties and responding to hostility with generosity and moral excellence.
